source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES sends CRPS1~2 as one literal status name and truncates discovery; it cannot prove two supplies, raw status sources, decoder semantics, FRU/feed mapping, role/freshness or UI fidelity.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly demands separate raw-to-decoded status evidence and vendor PMBus definitions without fault injection. V3.1 additionally binds serial/slot/feed/role, preserves simultaneous standard/OEM bits and keeps STATUS_PSU1~6 separate.

old_problem: PSU status may combine PMBus STATUS_WORD/STATUS_BYTE, subordinate and manufacturer-specific bits, with multiple simultaneous or sticky conditions. One range result or a green UI summary cannot prove two serial-bound supplies, decode raw faults, distinguish active/standby behavior or establish whether latch history is current.
disposition_reason: Bind STATUS_CRPS1 and STATUS_CRPS2 separately to immutable FRU/slot/feed/role identities and approved PMBus standard/OEM status sources. Preserve raw words and concurrent bit conditions, decode them with the versioned vendor definition, and verify both UI summaries and freshness without clearing history or inducing a fault. Missing Project/vendor bindings make execution NOT READY, not review Pending.
decision_basis: XLSX row 905, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, selection manifest, related dynamic CRPS case, adjacent numeric-power and six-PSU status families, and preserved V3.1 record were directly reviewed.
CRPS1/2 cannot be assumed to equal physical PSU1/2 or STATUS_PSU1/2; Project FRU/feed architecture must prove mapping and any aggregation.
Discrete/composite status correctness requires raw bits, decoder revision, role and timestamps; numeric thresholds are not required unless the status record explicitly supports them.

ED-03 forbids guessed OEM bits, ED-13 governs absent/standby states, ED-15 requires the approved decoder, ED-17 preserves fault history and ED-20 preserves two CRPS identities independently of six PSU statuses.

test_case.test_name: Verify STATUS_CRPS1 and STATUS_CRPS2 with serial/feed-bound raw PMBus decoding
test_case.purpose: Verify both intended CRPS status records are independently mapped to the correct physical supply, FRU serial, slot, AC feed and operating role and that their complete standard/OEM raw conditions are decoded and represented consistently in Dashboard and Server Health for the current redundancy state.
required_package: Chassis/power-backplane/BMC identity and authoritative CRPS1/2 versus PSU1-6 status architecture
CRPS1/2 slot, FRU PN/serial/model/firmware, AC feed, fitted state and active/standby/hot-spare/redundancy role
Vendor PMBus bus/address/page and STATUS_WORD/STATUS_BYTE/subordinate/OEM register definitions, polarity and decoder revision
Raw-bit map for present, input, output, fan, temperature, communication, power-good, standby, degraded and fault conditions including simultaneous bits
Stable SDR/API/UI identities, event masks, latch/sticky/clear behavior, BMC polling and UI propagation/freshness rules
Validated protected read-only BMC/browser client and pinned immutable reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual method
test_case.test_command: Do not clear SEL, PMBus fault history, BMC or PSU logs and do not remove/reseat a supply, switch feeds, change load/redundancy/hot-spare, reset PSU/BMC, clear faults, inject errors, write status/threshold registers or update firmware. Build the approved two-row FRU/feed/role/status-source matrix. Enumerate full inventory and read STATUS_CRPS1 and STATUS_CRPS2 separately; never submit the tilde expression or infer equality to STATUS_PSU1~6. Review the Script before use. Capture complete raw standard/OEM words/bytes, event masks, concurrent decoded states, latch/freshness metadata and timestamps plus matching Dashboard and Server Health views. Apply the versioned role/state decoder and stop without retry on stale, lost, swapped or divergent data.
test_case.expected_result: Both CRPS identities have explicit serial/slot/feed/role-bound results. Raw standard and OEM conditions decode according to the approved firmware reference, and both UI views accurately represent the applicable composite health without hiding an unaccepted concurrent bit. Normal, standby, absent, degraded and sticky-history behavior follows the current-role rules and is fresh; STATUS_PSU and numeric power data do not substitute.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires two independent mapped supplies, complete raw status sources and decoder provenance, synchronized UI evidence and engineer acceptance under current role/freshness/latch rules. A literal range, truncated fallback, generic healthy summary, numeric power value, guessed CRPS-to-PSU mapping or fabricated threshold cannot pass. Missing/swapped/stale identity, unrecognized/incorrectly decoded bit, unaccepted degraded/fault condition or raw/UI mismatch is FAIL. Missing FRU map, vendor status definition or role rules is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS. Physical presence transitions, AC loss, failover and fault clearing are separate coverage.
safety_gate: Preserve SEL, PMBus fault history, BMC and PSU logs; do not clear sticky evidence.
Read two exact FRU/feed-bound records and retain full standard/OEM status sources; do not infer equality to STATUS_PSU1~6.
Do not flatten multi-bit status into OK or require numeric thresholds where the discrete definition marks them not applicable.
Do not remove/reseat supplies, switch feeds, change load/redundancy/hot-spare, reset devices, clear faults, inject errors, write registers or update firmware.
Do not guess OEM bits, truncate output, expose credentials, assume a cipher or run an unreviewed Script; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Chassis/power-backplane/BMC identity and approved CRPS1/2-to-FRU/slot/feed/role map
Per-supply PMBus bus/address/page/register, stable SDR/API/UI identity and versioned standard/OEM raw-bit decoder
Complete raw status words/bytes/strings, simultaneous decoded conditions, event masks, latch/freshness metadata and synchronized timestamps
Dashboard and Server Health visual state with recorded presence, active/standby/hot-spare role and feed/redundancy health
Preserved fault history, no-service/no-fault-clear-or-injection/no-retry proof, final PSU/BMC health and per-CRPS engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is planned. On unknown bits, FRU/feed ambiguity, stale/lost status or unexpected health, stop and preserve raw words, fault history, UI and current redundancy state. Obtain the correct vendor decoder and Project mapping and continue only read-only; do not reset or clear faults to make the display look normal. Any later fault or failover test requires separate authorization and recovery.

source_conflict.reason: This passive row consistently requests CRPS status display/specification validation. Physical-removal/temperature conflicts are confined to another case; mapping and decoder gaps are readiness inputs.

blocked.reason: The two-supply passive raw-status objective is clear. Project FRU mapping and vendor PMBus definitions can provide exact semantics without fault injection.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: CRPS-to-FRU/slot/feed/role map, standard/OEM status sources and decoder, stable IDs, latch/poll/freshness behavior, role-specific absent/standby/degraded/unavailable rules and protected reviewed method.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; READ ONLY; NO PSU, FEED, LOAD, REDUNDANCY, RESET, FAULT-CLEAR/INJECTION, REGISTER OR FIRMWARE CHANGE; SCRIPT NOT APPROVED

external_authorities.title: Master-referenced internal sensor Script
external_authorities.application: Pin and review before use; it cannot establish FRU/feed mapping or vendor standard/OEM bit semantics.

project_authority: Project slot/feed/status architecture, CRPS vendor PMBus firmware specification, FRU inventory, BMC SDR/event mapping and WebUI schema define the two decoded outcomes.
